security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline template references, prose, CSS, and JavaScript RegExp.exec usage. The confirmed issues are intentional third-party CDN and Google Fonts dependencies in the documentation and viewer template, which add network, privacy, and supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: Generated artifacts load p5.js from a public CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a pinned p5.js copy with the skill, or require explicit user approval before using the CDN.

remediation.issue: The viewer template loads Google Fonts and preconnects to Google domains.
remediation.suggestion: Use bundled fonts or system fonts to avoid unexpected outbound requests from generated artifacts.

content.value_statement: Generative art requests can become vague code or static visuals. This skill turns concepts into seeded p5.js artwork with interactive controls and reusable templates.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of an algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Provides a p5.js viewer template with seed controls, sliders, colors, and reset actions.
Defines seeded randomness practices using randomSeed and noiseSeed.
Supports particle systems, flow fields, recursive structures, and parametric exploration.
Produces single-file HTML artifacts for browser or Claude artifact use.
limitations: The included viewer template depends on remote p5.js and Google Font URLs.
Generated code quality depends on the model following template markers.
The templates contain placeholder algorithm sections, not finished artworks.
Browser performance can drop with high particle counts or complex animations.

use_cases.title: Prototype Generative Artwork
use_cases.description: Turn an abstract visual idea into a seeded p5.js sketch with adjustable parameters.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Systems
use_cases.description: Create interactive studies of flow fields, particle behavior, recursion, or controlled randomness.

use_cases.title: Prepare Browser Artifacts
use_cases.description: Build a single HTML artifact that viewers can open and adjust without a local build step.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Art Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Create algorithmic art from this theme: [theme]. Include a short philosophy and one interactive p5.js artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Seeded Variation Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a seeded generative art system about [concept]. Make seed navigation clear and suggest three seeds worth viewing.

prompt_templates.title: Parameter Focused Artwork
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an interactive p5.js artwork about [subject]. Include parameters for density, motion, scale, and color behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced System Translation
prompt_templates.scenario: Translate a complex idea into rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this theory or reference into an original generative system: [details]. Explain the computational rules, then build the artifact.

output_examples.input: A request for art based on ocean currents and memory.
output_examples.output: A named algorithmic philosophy, a seeded flow-field concept, and an interactive viewer with controls for current strength, particle density, turbulence, and palette.

output_examples.input: A workshop prompt about recursion and urban growth.
output: A concise philosophy describing branching systems and constraints.
A browser-ready artwork with seed navigation and adjustable recursion depth.
Plain-language notes explaining which controls change the visual result.

best_practices: Start with the visual concept, then choose algorithms that express it.
Keep every random decision seeded so outputs can be reproduced.
Use parameters that change meaningful artistic behavior, not only surface style.
anti_patterns: Do not copy a known artist or ask for a direct imitation of living artists.
Do not replace the template structure with unrelated layout code.
Do not use unbounded particle counts or animation loops that can freeze the browser.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates original algorithmic art concepts and p5.js browser artifacts with seeded randomness and interactive controls.

faq.question: Can outputs be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs generated sketches to use seeds with randomSeed and noiseSeed.

faq.question: Does it require a build system?
faq.answer: No. The intended output is a single HTML artifact that opens in a browser.

faq.question: Can it make animated artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates support static or animated p5.js systems, depending on the concept.

faq.question: Are external resources used?
faq.answer: The included template loads p5.js and fonts from public URLs unless the author bundles them locally.

faq.question: Is this for copying art styles?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly directs creation of original generative systems instead of copying existing artists.
